title: Show the UTC offset on each location card
body:
Each location row in the Cards view shows only the city and the country. Add the
  location's current UTC offset next to them so the user can compare zones at a glance.

  - Format: UTC+3, UTC−5:30, UTC+5:45, UTC for zero offset. Use a real minus sign
    (U+2212). Show minutes only when they are not zero.
  - Compute the offset with the Temporal API from the location's IANA identifier, for the
    current instant. Daylight saving time must be respected: New York shows UTC−4 in July
    and UTC−5 in January.
  - The offset is computed when the list renders. It does not need to update live while
    the page stays open.
  - The UTC prefix goes through i18n (en and ru).
  - Tests use fakeClock from @/lib/temporal and cover a whole-hour zone, a half-hour zone
    (Asia/Kolkata), a 45-minute zone (Asia/Kathmandu), a DST switch and zero offset.

  Out of scope: differences from a home location, live clock, time of day.

report.question: Baseline is red, no files changed and no commits made. Passing: pnpm lint (6 warnings only), typecheck, test (844 passed), build, check:bundle-size. FAILING: `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client test:bdd` - 173 passed, 3 failed, all visual-regression screenshots 'Screenshot of the suggestions state at 375 px in the light/dark theme' (@add-locations-via-search @NFR-R2) in chromium (light, dark) and mobile-chrome (light): `expect(page).toHaveScreenshot failed - 3935 pixels (ratio 0.02) are different`. These specs are unrelated to the UTC offset change. Likely cause: the committed baselines under test/features/__screenshots__ were rendered on a different OS or font rendering, or Playwright browser version, than this macOS host (Node here is v26.10.0, .nvmrc says 26). Which fix do you want?
options: Fix the project and resume the task
Re-approve the 3 suggestions-state baselines on this machine (--update-snapshots), then resume
Proceed with the change and accept the 3 pre-existing screenshot failures
